about: Test fixture with the shape of recall_long.json at a small scale: two slice stores and an order system distributor on the shipment records (tier 1), order system accounts (tier 2) and a store named by a claim (tier 3) in the directory, a long-run schedule. Maple Farm milk powder 800 g, batch B-4471 (invented). All phone numbers are fictional 555-01xx numbers.

recall.instruction: Stop selling Maple Farm milk powder 800 g from batch B-4471. Take every tin of that batch off the shelf, keep the tins apart from stock for sale, and return them to Maple Farm Foods. Customers who bought a tin can bring it back to the store for a refund.

checks.label: Affected unit
checks.question: Read me the batch code printed under one tin.

checks.label: Sales are counted
checks.question: Open the item sales report on the till. How many have sold since the delivery?
checks.rule: sold needs a count read from the till

checks.label: Removal took effect
checks.question: Scan one tin at the till. Did the till refuse the sale?
